scheduleExpected: Bracket confirmed — Under 09 Boys Red Division (5 teams). SCUFC posts the full schedule, with game times, fields and pairings, on September 24, 2026 — and this app updates itself the moment it does.

updates.title: Hotel availability re-checked live — new list
updates.description: We re-ran availability for October 2–4, two adults and one child, and published a fresh list. Country Inn & Suites at Harbison is confirmed at $161 per night and is now our top pick. The Hampton Inn Harbison did not come back as available in any search — we have stopped recommending it. Rates come from a live Hotels.com search scoped to those exact dates; it is a partial result set, so a hotel missing from the list is unknown rather than sold out. Confirm the current price before booking.

updates.title: Bracket confirmed — Under 09 Boys Red Division
updates.description: Our bracket is posted and verified. Savannah United 17/18B Premier plays in Under 09 Boys Red Division (5 teams in total, listed in the guide below). Opponents are known; the schedule with times, fields and pairings posts September 24.

updates.title: No stay-to-play policy published for this event
updates.description: We checked the official tournament page, the SCUFC host site, and the registration portal, and found no stated housing requirement or approved-hotel list for the Carolina Cup. We have asked the tournament director to confirm. In the meantime, our hotel picks are simply the closest verified options — there is no housing portal to book through.

updates.title: Accepted team list posts September 14 — then complete online check-in
updates.description: The tournament posts accepted teams on September 14. Online check-in opens after that, and every team must complete it. There is no on-site check-in at this event, so this is not something that can be handled at the field.

updates.title: Brackets September 16 · Schedule September 24
updates.description: Brackets post September 16 and the full schedule posts September 24. Until the schedule lands we do not know which of SCUFC's five complexes our team plays at, what field, or what times. As soon as those are live, this app will show game times, fields, opponents, and a calculated departure time for each family.

updates.title: 2026 rules document not yet published
updates.description: SCUFC has not released the 2026 Carolina Cup rules. Game length, mercy rule, substitutions, and the tiebreaker order are all unconfirmed. Rather than fill these in from another tournament's rulebook, we have left them marked as pending. Rules questions can go to Tournament Director Tripp Miller at tripp@scufc.com.

bracket.note: Our bracket is confirmed. The tournament lists these teams in our division; the actual game-by-game pairings, times and fields arrive with the full schedule on September 24, 2026.
